title: The internet's seabed: every submarine cable, when it was laid, and the choke points
excerpt: 608 cables on the sea floor carry the internet between continents. I mapped when each was laid, how Google, Meta, Amazon and Microsoft came to part-own 55% of the planned length, and the straits and beaches where dozens squeeze through together.
seo_description: A map of every submarine internet cable: when each was laid, who owns them, and the straits and hubs where they crowd together.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The internet's seabed' beside a world map of every submarine cable coloured by the decade it was laid, indigo for the 1990s through blue, teal and amber to dashed coral for planned cables. Text: 608 submarine cables in service, 1.6 million km, and 105 planned.
